title: Amazon and Google Win Big From Anthropic IPO
summary: If you’re looking for a cheaper way of getting exposure to Anthropic than buying the stock directly, consider Amazon or Google. Anthropic’s updated IPO filing on Tuesday shows just how many shares each of those two tech giants will own in Anthropic, along with how much money they’re making on their early investments in the AI firm.Neither tech giant will own voting shares in Anthropic, so antitrust cops won’t have to worry about their influence over its management. But their stakes are significant. In theory, Amazon could own around 20% of Anthropic’s outstanding shares. But because of a self-imposed ownership cap, Amazon won’t hold more than 12% of Anthropic. The rest of its holdings are convertible notes that can convert to equity over time. Regardless, Amazon’s economic return is pretty damn good. Forgetting about the ownership cap for a minute, Amazon’s entire 20%-or-so stake would be worth about $258 billion at the midpoint of Anthropic’s proposed IPO pricing range. That’s from an investment totaling around $18.6 billion. (Anthropic’s final IPO price may well end up higher than the preliminary range,a Financial Times reporttonight suggests).
title_es: Amazon y Google multiplican inversión en Anthropic con su IPO
bajada: Amazon y Google obtendrán ganancias masivas de sus inversiones tempranas en Anthropic tras su salida a bolsa. Amazon podría ver su inversión de $18.6 mil millones convertirse en $258 mil millones, aunque se autoimpone un límite de participación del 12% para evitar problemas antimonopolio.
bajada_en: Amazon and Google will see massive returns on their early Anthropic investments following the company's IPO. Amazon's $18.6 billion investment could be worth around $258 billion at the midpoint of the IPO pricing, though it self-imposes a 12% ownership cap to avoid antitrust concerns.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
title_es: Nueva York aplicará ley de seguridad en IA a OpenAI y Anthropic
bajada: Nueva York comienza a hacer cumplir su ley integral de seguridad en IA, requiriendo que desarrolladores como OpenAI y Anthropic se registren, divulguen prácticas de seguridad y reporten incidentes críticos o enfrentem multas.
bajada_en: New York is enforcing its comprehensive AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
summary: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
title_es: Grok Build expone datos confidenciales de 35,000 aplicaciones
bajada: Un investigador descubrió que 35,000 aplicaciones Grok Build estaban expuestas públicamente, incluyendo información confidencial de SpaceX. El incidente revela vulnerabilidades críticas en la plataforma de agentes de programación.
bajada_en: A researcher discovered that 35,000 Grok Build apps were publicly exposed, including confidential information from SpaceX. The incident reveals critical vulnerabilities in the coding agent platform.

title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
summary: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
title_es: Los 7 fundadores de Anthropic obtendrán $250M cada uno en la IPO
bajada: Los cofundadores de Anthropic venderán partes iguales en la oferta pública, generando aproximadamente $250 millones en efectivo cada uno al precio medio propuesto, mientras mantienen el control de la empresa.
bajada_en: Anthropic's seven co-founders will each sell equal share amounts in the IPO, generating around $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while retaining company control.

title: CoreWeave Reports Revenue Surge But Huge Increase in Cash Burn
summary: CoreWeave reported third quarter revenue of $3.66 billion, more than double the year earlier number of $1.365 billion, but its losses also ballooned.CoreWeave’s net loss for the quarter jumped to $709 million, reflecting a huge increase in CoreWeave’s interest costs on its debt, to $846 million ...
title_es: CoreWeave duplica ingresos pero dispara su quema de efectivo
bajada: CoreWeave reportó ingresos del Q3 de $3.66 mil millones, más del doble respecto a hace un año, pero las pérdidas netas saltaron a $709 millones, principalmente por costos de intereses en deuda que alcanzaron $846 millones.
bajada_en: CoreWeave reported Q3 revenue of $3.66 billion, more than double year-over-year, but net losses jumped to $709 million, primarily due to debt interest costs of $846 million.

title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.

bajada_en: Google Cloud launches Gemini for Healthcare, a solution that unifies clinical data and automates workflows to reduce administrative burden in hospitals and healthcare systems.

bajada_en: Apple is developing a new Mac app to simplify running local AI models. The tool aims to democratize access to generative AI without relying on remote servers.

title: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
summary: DeepMind researchers were able to formally verify that the widely used encryption protocol works as intended. Their stretch goal? Do the same for “all the software of the world.”
title_es: DeepMind verifica formalmente que Signal Protocol es seguro
bajada: Investigadores de Google DeepMind utilizaron una nueva herramienta de IA para verificar formalmente que el protocolo de encriptación Signal funciona como se pretende. Su objetivo a largo plazo es hacer lo mismo para todo el software.
bajada_en: Google DeepMind researchers used a new AI tool to formally verify that the widely-used Signal encryption protocol works as intended. Their long-term goal is to verify all software.

bajada: OpenAI ha adquirido Odessia, una startup de viajes creada por Francis Davidson, fundador de Sonder. Aún no hay claridad sobre los planes futuros de OpenAI en el sector de viajes.
bajada_en: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup created by Sonder founder Francis Davidson. The company hasn't disclosed its future plans for the travel space yet.
